scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n API,WEB,CRM -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:sandbox"
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace @ares/web && npm run lint:backend
scripts.format:check: npm run format:check --workspace @ares/web && python -m ruff format --check backend apps/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @ares/web && npm run typecheck:backend
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @ares/web && npm run test:backend
scripts.quality: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
